Provident Real Estate proudly presents a refined 3-bedroom in the sought-after Rukan 3, ideally situated within the vibrant Dubailand community. This elegant townhouse offers a perfect blend of modern design, comfort, and convenience.

Property Highlights

Configuration: 3 spacious bedrooms
Bathrooms: 4 contemporary bathrooms
Balcony: Expansive corner balcony offering added privacy and open views, with no direct overlooking
Kitchen: Stylish open-plan kitchen fitted with integrated appliances
Furnishing: Tastefully furnished with modern, high-quality interiors
Upgrades: Recently enhanced with premium finishes
Parking: 1 allocated parking space
Status: Vacant and ready for immediate occupancy

Community Amenities

Separate swimming pools for adults and children
Fully equipped fitness center and modern gym facilities
Beautifully landscaped green areas with shaded seating
Designated BBQ and outdoor picnic areas
Versatile open lawns for leisure and activities
Dedicated jogging and cycling paths
Safe and engaging children’s play zones
Gated community with round-the-clock security and controlled access

Nearby Destinations

Global Village: 3.7 km
Dubai Miracle Garden: 4.7 km
Mudon Central Park: 2.8 km
Golf Club: 7.4 km
Downtown Dubai / Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall: Approximately 20 minutes
Dubai International Airport (DXB): Approximately 25 minutes
